evidence_policy: Only observed raw bytes from public release archives are accepted. Every archive SHA-256 and document payload-manifest entry was verified. Source files are provenance, never alternate cleanup hashes. No newline, whitespace, encoding or BOM normalization is used for matching installed files.
installation_verification: This inventory establishes archive contents and source-defined installation paths; it is not evidence of a completed native installation, upgrade, repair or uninstall.
license_preservation: COPYRIGHT.txt, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and historical reference JSON containing structured license/copyright/attribution records are preserved. Unknown or modified files, links, user IR/preset/project paths are outside the cleanup authority.

windows.scope: Previously selected app path may differ; do not discover or sweep other installations.

linux_deb.evidence: Shared source staging layout confirmed; downloaded archive evidence is Linux TAR, not the Debian archive.
